visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: A pipe Helper Instead of Numbered Steps
visualizerParams.problemDescription: A string is cleaned in three separate steps with throw-away variables. Write small functions and chain them with a pipe helper. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: Each step is now a named function that can be tested and reused, and slugify is simply the list of steps in order. Throw-away variables like step1 and step2 disappear.
